command: DECOMP_REQUIRE_LIVE_ACP_CONTRACT=1 JAVA_OPTS='-Xmx8g' ./gradlew --offline test --console=plain -Pkotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process -x verifyFrontendToolchain -x frontendInstall -x frontendBuild -x generateFrontendAssetManifest -x verifyFrontendAssets --tests 'decompengine.repair.TraceGuidedRepairTest.active ACP repair admits exact stored blob bytes and removes one byte over candidate blob'

scope.provider: scripted ACP process through the active repair loop
scope.coverage: Paired fresh projects start with 485 uniquely referenced source-blob bytes. The 4,096-byte candidate is accepted at the exact 4,581-byte stored-blob ceiling and reaches the injected validator. The 4,097-byte candidate is acknowledged by the ACP write and read callbacks, then graph admission refuses at 4,582 bytes against the 4,581-byte ceiling before validation. Both cases bind the receipt to the observed modified path, before/after hashes and byte size; preserve accepted source/head; clear pending state; and verify process and sandbox cleanup. Reopening the graph confirms exact stored-byte accounting, and the over-limit case confirms the unreferenced candidate blob is removed while all baseline blobs remain.
